name: exec-productivity
description: The keys to start with Claude on your own work, in one guided install. Context makes the difference: your mail, calendar, chat, documents and meetings read with your own access, and a Super Context kept current every morning. Claude beyond a chat: a daily brief and a priority inbox, pages it writes and keeps current on a schedule. Your own use cases: every weekday evening, what you could have asked Claude, with the prompt, what to attach and the connections. Sends nothing, deletes nothing.
